## Validation

Paste validation output from:

```bash
scripts/nexus packages validate /path/to/package
```

## Safety checklist

- [ ] The release asset URL is an HTTPS GitHub URL.
- [ ] The SHA-256 checksum was computed from the uploaded release asset.
- [ ] The package contains no secrets, credentials, tokens, or private keys.
- [ ] The package contains no install hooks, scripts, shell commands, or runtime
      data.
- [ ] The package validates locally with LM-Nexus.
- [ ] Declared permissions and dependencies are accurate.
